description: MainActivity.java defines an Android activity that manages a permission request UI, handles menu options for toggling logs, and initializes logging components.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages permission requests, menu options, and logging setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the PermissionRequestFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu, toggling visibility and title of the log toggle item based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
